included: one evidence-selected write-point reliability or security primary from a closed metric profile
stable receipt completeness as the causal observability diagnostic
normal-write success non-inferiority and zero-tolerance write integrity redlines
not_applicable: portfolio-wide writer migration: exactly one write entry is permitted
not_measured: the selected primary value until TASK-P12D-010 names the write entry and freezes one metric before candidate measurement

primary_result.formula: TASK-P12D-010 must select exactly one before unblinding: duplicate_effect_rate_per_10k_intents OR partial_write_or_event_loss_rate_per_10k_intents OR ambiguous_outcome_manual_repair_minutes_per_1k_intents OR stale_conflict_partial_effect_rate_per_10k_intents
primary_result.numerator: event or duration numerator for the single selected root-cause metric; no composite mixing is allowed
primary_result.denominator: all eligible intents for the selected write entry including failed retried and ambiguous attempts, or 1000 intents for the duration profile
primary_result.success_definition: selected root-cause outcome improves under the preregistered exact estimator with normal-write guardrails and all redlines passing
primary_result.failure_definition: selected outcome misses its bound, the metric is changed after unblinding, sample is underpowered, or any redline fails

diagnostic.formula: terminal command attempts with a schema-valid stable receipt / all terminal command attempts
diagnostic.numerator: terminal attempts with receipt binding command version target principal approval idempotency versions state outbox policy and schema digests
diagnostic.denominator: all committed denied conflicted rejected and recovered terminal command attempts
diagnostic.threshold: 1.0 for the candidate contract but not sufficient to claim behavior improvement
diagnostic.success_definition: every terminal outcome is unambiguous and reconstructable without sensitive body content
diagnostic.failure_definition: missing malformed ambiguous or content-leaking receipt

guardrails.numerator: candidate-minus-baseline successful normal intents under identical request and dependency conditions
guardrails.denominator: all preregistered non-fault normal intent pairs
guardrails.success_definition: one-sided 95 percent lower bound exceeds the frozen negative margin
guardrails.failure_definition: bound fails, sample is underpowered, or normal denials are hidden as security success

redlines.formula: count(logical command intents producing more than one formal business side effect or logical outbox event)
redlines.denominator: all semantic retry concurrent duplicate crash and relay replay cases
redlines.failure_definition: any intent commits or emits more than one logical effect

redlines.formula: count(business mutations or outbox events committed without current server-derived authorization approval and tenant scope)
redlines.denominator: all adversarial authorization approval replay RLS and TOCTOU cases
redlines.failure_definition: any denied stale revoked forged or cross-tenant command changes formal state

redlines.formula: count(committed mutations without one logical outbox event plus outbox events without a committed mutation)
redlines.denominator: all normal fault-injection restore reconciliation and relay-replay cases
redlines.failure_definition: business truth and logical event truth diverge

redlines.formula: count(committed outcomes lost after restore or impossible to classify from durable state and receipt)
redlines.denominator: all commit-boundary kill replay restore and reconciliation cases
redlines.failure_definition: a committed outcome is lost duplicated or cannot be resolved deterministically

statistical_plan.comparison_unit: logical intent for the single selected write entry, clustered by target resource and concurrency episode
statistical_plan.pairing: legacy and command paths use equivalent request fixtures dependency snapshots and fault schedules; synthetic fault runs are labelled mechanics-only
statistical_plan.estimator: closed profile selects exact binomial event-rate difference with Clopper-Pearson bounds or clustered bootstrap difference in repair minutes
statistical_plan.interval_method: exact one-sided event-rate bounds for rare counts; clustered bootstrap only for duration profile, selected before candidate unblinding
statistical_plan.missing_run_handling: candidate-caused timeout receipt gap or unresolved outcome is failure; symmetric infrastructure-only exclusion requires durable proof and applies to the pair
statistical_plan.outlier_handling: no event or repair episode is removed; duration reports median p95 and full-tail sensitivity with reasons for externally censored episodes
statistical_plan.multiple_comparison_rule: TASK-P12D-010 selects one primary from the closed profile; switching after unblinding invalidates the STAR, and no primary improvement can offset a redline

decision_rule: begin or continue allocation only if TASK-P12D-010 selected one primary from the closed profile before unblinding, its 95 percent improvement bound passes, normal-write success is non-inferior, receipt coverage is complete, and every write-integrity redline is zero
no_claim_boundary: duplicate_formal_write_count equals zero is a hard redline and capability proof, not by itself a behavior-improvement primary
fault injection proves crash and replay mechanics but cannot estimate a production incident-rate reduction
without a named write entry there is no valid denominator or primary result and the STAR remains measurement_pending
a composite of duplicate unauthorized partial and ambiguous outcomes is prohibited because it could hide a redline
migration or receipt coverage alone proves capability and governance, not value improvement
